findings.summary: Exact matching replaces prefix matching. A declaration is now recognised only in the metadata table cell or at the start of a line, so prose mentioning a verdict cannot become one.
Ambiguity is surfaced rather than resolved. Two different declarations return AMBIGUOUS, which is deliberately not a permitted verdict, so the existing enum check rejects it without a new rule.

Scope attribution is weak for untracked directories: git collapses tools/ to one entry, so file-level changes there are unattributable rather than scope-checked. Reported honestly by the tool, and a real limitation of governing an uncommitted tree.

notes: APPROVE. The convergence standard was not weakened: the permitted verdict set is unchanged and the parser is now stricter than before.
